capabilities: Insert styled button blocks into notes via a command
Upload animated icons in GIF, APNG, and WebP formats
Configure label, colors, corners, and animation per button
Run an Obsidian command by ID or open a URL from a button
Arrange buttons in a wrapping row inside a button-row callout
extras: Not available through the community plugin store; installed by copying the folder into the vault manually, and it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create styled, clickable buttons inside notes with custom icon images.
summary: Plugin that inserts custom styled buttons into notes, using icons you upload, which run an Obsidian command or open a URL.
